title: Patch updates
summary: On a build made by T3 Patcher (with <T3 home>/userdata/patcher/installed.json), the sidebar's update pill offers newer versions of the installed patches from the patcher's feed, and new T3 Code versions, and Update runs the patcher's update command (rebuild with every patch, check, install, relaunch) instead of electron-updater, showing its steps live. T3CODE_PATCH_UPDATE_FEED overrides the feed.

checks.name: desktop update tests
checks.run: . "$T3_PATCHER_ENV" && cd apps/desktop && vp test run src/updates/DesktopPatchUpdates.test.ts src/updates/DesktopUpdates.patched.test.ts src/updates/DesktopUpdates.test.ts src/app/DesktopApp.test.ts

checks.name: web update tests
checks.run: . "$T3_PATCHER_ENV" && export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH="${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:-$BE/ms-playwright}" && cd apps/web && pnpm exec playwright install chromium-headless-shell && vp test run --project unit src/state/desktopPatchUpdate.test.ts src/components/sidebar/patchUpdate.logic.test.ts && vp test run --project browser src/components/sidebar/SidebarPatchUpdatePill.browser.test.tsx src/components/sidebar/SidebarUpdatePill.browser.test.tsx

journeys.name: patch_updates
journeys.proves: On a patched build (an installed record in a throwaway T3 home) with update checks on against local feeds only, the sidebar's update pill lists a newer journey-kit and T3 Code 0.1.12 but not uninstalled patches; Update runs the record's command with --t3 0.1.12, --relaunch <the app's pid> and the record's PATH, and the popover shows the stub's steps in words as they run and pass.
